newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL overnight rate falls on fresh liquidity.
newsitem.headline: KL overnight rate falls on fresh liquidity.

text.p: The overnight interbank rate fell to 7.10 percent against 8.00 percent on Friday due to fresh liquidity in the market, dealers said on Monday.
They said the maturity of a central bank deposit increased liquidity and raised the number of interbank offers in the afternoon session.
"The maturity is finally having an impact. The market was cautious in the morning and people were waiting for the overnight to determine the direction of rates," a dealer with a local bank said.
He said the market was cautious after rates refused to budge on Friday despite a 500 million ringgit Bank Negara bill maturity.
Earlier, interbank rates remained firm as the market remained short despite the maturity, dealers said.
They said there was a maturity of a one-month deposit raised by Bank Negara as part of its open market operations.
